task.title: kanban-quick command which will allow us to essentially bypass all processes and allow us implement something quickly. Socratic QA to gather context then it just does the implementation and commits.
task.description: Create a \"kanban-quick\" command that accelerates extremely small changes by skipping the full kanban flow while still capturing a minimal conversational QA record and automatically running the requested implementation plus commit.
task.problem: Full kanban flow is heavy for tiny fixes, so there is no official way to run a super fast path that still records intent before executing work.
task.value: Provide a guarded fast lane that keeps a short Socratic QA transcript, runs the change immediately, and commits automatically so small requests stop getting bogged down.
task.acceptance-criteria: Given a user needs a tiny change and invokes the kanban-quick command And they provide context through a short Socratic QA exchange When the command confirms the request Then it executes the requested implementation steps immediately And it commits the result with an appropriate message And it surfaces any guardrails (confirmation prompts, scope limits, or fallbacks) so the user understands the safety boundaries
